source: During training, the forward pass produces activations needed by backward propagation. Backward computes gradients and may read saved activations or recompute them. Optimizers maintain additional parameterassociated state. The system therefore moves and stores far more than model weights alone.
zh: 在训练过程中，前向传播会产生反向传播所需的激活。向后计算梯度并可以读取保存的激活或重新计算它们。优化器维护附加参数关联状态。因此，该系统移动和存储的量远远多于模型重量。
